single_func_point_2d.description: Return a JSON array of objects each containing 'functional_point_2d' as a list-of-points [[x,y]], a 'label' and optional 'confidence'.

single_func_point_3d.description: Return a JSON array of objects each containing 'functional_point_3d' as a list-of-3D-points [[x,y,z]], a 'label' and optional 'confidence'.

grasp_point_2d.description: Return an array containing one or more objects each with 'grasp_point_2d' as [x,y] in image pixels and an optional 'label'.

grasp_point_3d.description: Return an array containing one or more objects each with 'grasp_point_3d' as [x,y,z] in meters and an optional 'label'.

multi_func_point_2d.description: Return an array of candidate objects each with 'functional_point_2d' (flat [x,y] inside a list), 'label', and optional 'score'.

all_part_point_2d.description: Return an array containing all detected part points; each object has 'functional_point_2d' as [x,y] and an optional 'label'.

single_part_point_2d.description: Return an array containing one object with 'functional_point_2d' as [x,y] representing a single detected part point, along with an optional 'label' and optional 'description'.

object_point_qa_detect_all_2d.description: Return an array containing all detected object centers in the image; each object has 'center_2d' as [x,y] in pixels and an optional 'label'.

object_point_qa_detect_category_2d.description: Return an array containing one object representing the detected instances of the requested category (e.g., all 'orange' instances collapsed to a single representative).

object_point_qa_single_with_desc_2d.description: Return an array containing one object with 'center_2d' as [x,y], an optional 'label', and an optional 'description' field for human-readable details.

object_point_qa_detect_all_3d.description: Return an array containing all detected object centers in 3D; each object has 'center_3d' as [x,y,z] in meters and an optional 'label'.

object_point_qa_detect_category_3d.description: Return an array containing one object representing the detected instances of the requested 3D category (single representative center_3d).

object_point_qa_single_with_desc_3d.description: Return an array containing one object with 'center_3d' as [x,y,z], an optional 'label', and an optional 'description' field for human-readable details.

all_part_point_3d.description: Return an array containing all detected 3D part points; each object has 'functional_point_3d' as [x,y,z] and an optional 'label'.

single_part_point_3d.description: Return an array containing one object with 'functional_point_3d' as [x,y,z] representing a single detected 3D part point, along with an optional 'label' and optional 'description'.

multi_func_point_3d.description: Same as multi_func_point_2d but with 3D points in 'functional_point_3d'.

multi_func_vector_2d.description: Return an array of objects each with 'functional_vector' as a list-of-2D-vectors [[vx,vy]] and an optional 'label' describing the action/role.

multi_func_vector_3d.description: Return an array of objects each with 'functional_vector' as a 3D vector [vx,vy,vz] (unit or direction vector) and an optional 'label' describing the action/role.

single_func_vector_2d.description: Return an array containing one object with 'functional_vector' as a list-of-2D-vectors [[vx,vy]] (use the same shape as multi_func_vector_2d) and an optional 'label'.

single_func_vector_3d.description: Return an array containing one object with 'functional_vector' as a 3D vector [vx,vy,vz] (same shape as multi_func_vector_3d) and an optional 'label'.

spatial_rel_qa_obj2cam_distance.description: Return an array with at least one object containing numeric 'distance_meters' (meters).

spatial_rel_qa_obj2obj_distance.description: Return an array with at least one object containing numeric 'distance_meters' (meters).

spatial_rel_obj2obj_choice.description: Return an array with one object with 'spatial_relation_choice' set to the chosen option (single uppercase letter) and optional 'label'.

obj_bbox_qa_single_with_desc_3d.alt-description: Return an array containing one object with 'bbox_3d' (center + size and optional rotation fields; at least first 6 values: [cx,cy,cz,sx,sy,sz]) and an optional 'label' and 'description'.
obj_bbox_qa_single_with_desc_3d.description:
Please output each 3D bounding box in the following JSON format exactly (an array of objects):
[{"bbox_3d":[x_center, y_center, z_center, x_size, y_size, z_size, roll, pitch, yaw], "label":"category"}]

Notes:
(1) x_center, y_center, z_center: center of the object in the camera coordinate system, in meters.
(2) x_size, y_size, z_size: object dimensions along the X, Y, Z axes respectively (meters) when rotation angles are zero.
(3) roll, pitch, yaw: Euler angles (radians) representing rotations around X, Y, Z axes respectively.
Detect all objects in this image and return the results as the JSON array above.

obj_bbox_qa_detect_category_3d.description: Return an array containing one object with 'bbox_3d' (center + size and optional rotation fields; at least first 6 values: [cx,cy,cz,sx,sy,sz]) and an optional 'label' and 'description'.

obj_bbox_qa_detect_all_3d.description: Return an array containing all detected objects each with 'bbox_3d' (center + size and optional rotation fields; at least first 6 values: [cx,cy,cz,sx,sy,sz]) and an optional 'label'.

2d_oriented_bbox_qa_detect_all.description: Return an array containing all detected objects each with 'oriented_bbox_2d' (cx, cy, width, height, angle) and an optional 'label'.

2d_oriented_bbox_qa_detect_category.description: Return an array containing one object with 'oriented_bbox_2d' (cx, cy, width, height, angle) and an optional 'label' and 'description'.

2d_oriented_bbox_qa_single_with_desc.description: Return an array containing one object with 'oriented_bbox_2d' (cx, cy, width, height, angle), an optional 'label', and optional 'description' field for human-readable details.

2d_oriented_bbox_qa_detect_all_parts.description: Return an array containing all detected object parts each with 'oriented_bbox_2d' (cx, cy, width, height, angle) and an optional 'label' that may include part suffixes (e.g., 'object--Part').

2d_oriented_bbox_qa_single_part_with_des.description: Return an array containing one object representing a single detected part with 'oriented_bbox_2d', an optional 'label', and optional 'description' for human-readable details.

3d_bbox_qa_detect_all_parts.description: Return an array containing all detected object parts each with 'bbox_3d' (cx, cy, cz, sx, sy, sz and optional rotation fields) and an optional 'label' that may include part suffixes (e.g., 'object--Part').

3d_bbox_qa_single_part_with_desc.description: Return an array containing one object representing a single detected 3D part with 'bbox_3d' (center + size and optional rotation fields), an optional 'label', and optional 'description' for human-readable details.

correspondence_pairs_customized_2d.description: Return an array of correspondence pair objects each with 'label', 'description', 'point_2d' as [x,y], and boolean 'visible'.

correspondence_pairs_single_object_2d.description: Return an array containing one correspondence pair object for a single 2D object with fields 'label','description','point_2d', and 'visible'.

correspondence_pairs_customized_3d.description: Return an array of correspondence pair objects each with 'label', 'description', 'point_3d' as [x,y,z in meters] (z within 1.0m), and boolean 'visible'.

correspondence_pairs_single_object_3d.description: Return an array containing one correspondence pair object for a single 3D object with fields 'label','description','point_3d' (z within 1.0m), and 'visible'.

traj_qa_prediction_2d.description: Return an object containing '2d_trajectory' whose value is a list of 2D points [[x,y], ...].

traj_qa_prediction_3d.description: Return an object containing '3d_trajectory' whose value is a list of 3D points [[x,y,z], ...].
